item.title: Scootin’ for Scoops with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Mon Aug 24 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Enjoy a 5-star Lancaster County ice cream tour experience with Strasburg Scooter Tours. You’ll see rolling farmlands, pass by horse and buggies, and enjoy some of the best Ice Cream in Lancaster County! It’s a stark contrast to the usual fast-paced and congested areas of larger cities. For those craving something different or one of the best romantic date night ideas, join us! We designed this tour to be an experience you can share with someone. We’ll only use Scoot Coupes, so single riders will have to look for someone to bring on the tour. It will be well worth it as you can expect exceptional views. Bond throughout the experience alongside our expert guide and relish some tasty ice cream* as we Ride around the rolling farmland surrounding the Village of Intercourse and Bird-in-Hand, PA. >> Check Out Our Ice Cream Tour in Strasburg, PA Itinerary Some of our past tours have included:

item.title: Bastidas Soccer Academy Training Camp — Mon Aug 24, 9:00 AM — Manheim Central Middle School
item.description:
Established in 1999, the Bastidas Soccer Academy emphasizes the importance of basic skill and ball mastery. We are passionate about teaching you to have fun and develop a winning attitude. All boys and girls from any school or district, entering grades 3-8, are invited to attend this premier camp to kick off the fall season. Registration is $200 per player (or $190 each for a sibling group) and will include:
Camp T-shirt USSF Licensed Coaches (including “A” License coach Trajano Bastidas) and USYS ODP Coaches Camp features– league play, king of the hill, soccer dance, small sided games, stations Main focuses– first touch, passing, receiving, finishing, having fun!
Players should arrive at least 10 minutes early each day with proper attire, sneakers, cleats, shin guards, plenty of water, and a snack for the mid-point break. Questions? item.title: Wednesday Morning's Breakfast Rides Casual Pace Variable Distance RSVP — Wed Aug 26, 8:30 AM
item.description: Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup During July and August our breakfast ride begins at 8:30. In case of excessive heat, we will ride shorter distances. Every Wednesday morning...Ride and eat Yummy breakfast together. Around 25 miles. Please do not go on this ride unless you will ride at a casual pace and stay with the group . We will meet to ride to breakfast at a casual pace. After eating some may split up with some returning to the start and others going longer and faster. Helmets are mandatory; No ear buds or audible music playing devices. Please bring water, and a basic repair kit (spare tube, tire levers, pump/CO2 inflator). To eliminate passing around a pen and paper waiver, we encourage LBC Club membership and Meetup RSVP below to join this ride. RSVP also allows us to contact you after the ride if needed. item.title: Evening Compline — Fri Aug 28, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster
